programmes.d: Based on the terrifying true story, firearm heiress Sarah Winchester believes she is haunted by the souls of people killed by the Winchester repeating rifle, leading her to build a never-ending mansion to house the tortured souls of the dead.
A teenage girl in the Midwest becomes infected by an outbreak of a disease that slowly turns the infected into cannibalistic zombies. During her transformation, her loving father stays by her side.
A father invokes the demon Pumpkinhead to avenge his son's death at the hands of big-city bikers in this Horrorror classic filled with the essence of evil.
